stack: Next.js 15.5 App Router, React, TypeScript, Tailwind 3, Supabase (Auth, Postgres + RLS, Storage) via @supabase/ssr, Recharts, Vercel; PWA for workers

surfaces.name: Management shell (owner, Operation Manager, supervisor)
surfaces.layout: Fixed left sidebar (w-60 = 240px, full height, white, right border) from lg (1024px) up; below lg the sidebar becomes a left drawer opened by a hamburger. Content column has a sticky floating top bar card (58px high on phone, 64px from sm, rounded 20/24px, inside a 16-24px gutter) and a scrolling main area (p-4, lg:p-6). Profile menu sits in the sidebar footer, not the top bar.

brand.logo: public/brand/antarax-ax-ripple-centered.svg (BrandMark, 32px) in the sidebar head; top bar BrandPill = public/brand/antarax-mark.svg (22px, links to https://antarax.ai) + public/brand/ripple-icon.svg (24px) on a white chip
brand.name_text: Yara (brand.productName, env NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_NAME); top bar chip text in teal #067A7C
brand.credit_line: Powered by AntaraX Ripple (sidebar head, 11px muted, from brand.poweredBy / NEXT_PUBLIC_PLATFORM_ENGINE)
brand.other: Tenant identity chip in the top bar: company logo (signed URL) or 2-letter initials tile + company name, hidden below sm. No version or build text in the customer shell.

items.label: Production setup
items.gating: role only; page has tabs: standards and rates, calendar, resources (equipment), thresholds

items.label: User guide
items.gating: leaves the shell: /guide and /help render as standalone pages without the sidebar

global_controls.search: Top bar search field 'Search Work Orders, Job Cards, users…' (max-w-sm, 44px high, grey #EFF2F6 fill, teal focus) submits to /search?q=; below sm it collapses to a round search button that expands the field over the bar with a close (X) button
global_controls.notifications: Bell (44px round) in the top bar linking to /notifications; red count badge (#F04438, '9+' cap); count polled every 60s from /api/notifications/unread-count and refreshed on tab focus
global_controls.help: Help item in the sidebar footer group (/help); 'FAQ & Support' in the user menu; floating '?' button bottom right re-opens the per-page guide card
global_controls.guide: User guide item in the sidebar (/guide) and in the user menu
global_controls.org_switcher: none; read-only tenant chip (logo/initials + name) in the top bar
global_controls.product_switcher: none; AntaraX 'A' in the brand pill links out to https://antarax.ai
global_controls.create_button: Not global. '+ New Work Order' primary button on the dashboard header (hidden for supervisors without supervisor_can_create_work_order)
global_controls.ai_entry: none (ai_intake_enabled flag exists, off by default, no UI entry)
global_controls.language: none in the management shell (English only)
global_controls.sign_out: 'Log out' in the sidebar-footer user menu, with a confirm dialog ('Log out?'), then redirect to /login
other: Per-page guide card (PageGuide) with 'Take the tour' link and 'Got it' dismiss, stored in localStorage
Guided tours anchored on data-tour attributes (Tour.tsx)

surfaces.responsive: lg (1024px) and up: fixed 240px sidebar. Below lg: sidebar hidden, hamburger (44px round) at the left of the top bar opens the same Sidebar as a left drawer over a 30% black scrim (focus trap, Escape closes, closes on navigate). Below sm (640px): search collapses to an icon, tenant chip hidden, top bar 58px instead of 64px. No bottom bar.
surfaces.active_state: Longest matching route prefix wins. Active item: teal tint background #E1F6F6 (ripple-tealTint) with teal-dark text and icon #078F92, radius 8px; inactive: muted grey #6B7280 text, icon at 70% opacity, hover bg gray-50

colours.antarax_blue: #0459F7 (focus ring on top-bar controls, range picker active)

surfaces.fonts: Poppins 400/500/600/700 (next/font, --font-poppins) for all UI; JetBrains Mono (--font-mono) only in a few places in the customer app (running timer). KPI values are Poppins, not mono.
surfaces.a11y: Skip to content link; drawer has role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap and Escape; icon buttons have aria-labels; bell aria-label includes unread count; focus-visible ring on top-bar controls only (blue #0459F7, offset 2px); nav links have no explicit focus ring; nav icons aria-hidden; 44px targets in the top bar. Reduced motion handled only in Tour.tsx (motion-reduce); the PageGuide and modal animations are not guarded.
surfaces.role_variants: owner and om see all 4 groups (17 items). supervisor sees Dashboard, Work Orders, Job Cards, Team Tasks, Help, User guide only (Setup group hidden; Projects, Customers, Invite, Users, Activity Log hidden) and no money panel on the dashboard. reka_admin is redirected from /dashboard to /axle and gets the AXLE variant of the same shell. worker never reaches this shell (redirected to /worker).

widgets.title: Dashboard
widgets.detail: H1 + subtitle 'Live view of <company> operations' (supervisor: 'Your assigned Work Orders and Job Cards'); '+ New Work Order' primary button on the right

widgets.title: Your operations at a glance (page guide)
widgets.detail: Dismissable teal-tint card with 3 tips and 'Take the tour' link; bottom sheet on phones; becomes a floating ? button once dismissed. A 7-step guided tour runs on first visit.

widgets.title: Needs attention
widgets.detail: Live alert list from company_alerts RPC (stalled between stages, worker red, resource idle, forecast miss, step overridden); left border coloured by severity (danger red, warning orange, info blue); each links to the job card, work order or /team; hidden entirely when there are no alerts

widgets.title: Money tiles (owner, om only)
widgets.detail: 5 StatCards: Total order value, Completed value (green), In-progress value (teal), On-hold value (orange), Overdue value at risk (red when > 0); formatted 'RM 550,634.00'. Not affected by the range picker.

widgets.title: Order value by month (owner, om only)
widgets.detail: Recharts area chart, blue line with gradient fill

widgets.title: Top customers by value (owner, om only)
widgets.detail: Recharts horizontal bar chart, top 5, teal bars

widgets.title: Range picker
widgets.detail: Segmented buttons 7 days / 30 days (default) / 90 days / All time; active = blue tint. Applies to the operational section below only.

widgets.title: Operational tiles
widgets.detail: 6 StatCards: Work Orders, In progress (teal), Active Job Cards (teal), On hold (orange), Overdue WOs (red when > 0), Completed today (green)

widgets.title: Job Cards completed per day
widgets.detail: Recharts area chart (teal), spans 2 of 3 columns, subtitle 'Last N days'

widgets.title: Time summary
widgets.detail: Definition list (Avg Work Order time, Avg Job Card time, Bottleneck stage) plus two small donut charts (Work Orders by status, Job Cards by status)

widgets.title: Avg hours per stage
widgets.detail: Recharts vertical bar chart (blue); empty text 'No completed Job Cards in this period.'

widgets.title: Jobs completed per worker
widgets.detail: Recharts vertical bar chart (teal)

widgets.title: Module slot dashboard.panel
widgets.detail: Renders add-on module panels when a module is enabled for the tenant; nothing otherwise

surfaces.name: Yara AXLE (REKA platform console)
surfaces.host_or_route: axle.yara.antarax.ai in production (middleware rewrites / to /axle); /axle on one host when NEXT_PUBLIC_AXLE_HOST/APP_HOST are unset
entry_files: src/app/(app)/layout.tsx:9 (same layout as the customer shell)
surfaces.layout: Same AppShell as the customer app, switched to dark nav: 240px ink sidebar (#0B0E14) with a 24px blueprint grid, dark floating top bar card (#12151E). The content area stays light (#F7FAFC) with white 'panel-axle' cards.

brand.logo: public/brand/antarax-ax-ripple-centered.svg (32px) in the sidebar head; same A + Ripple brand pill in the top bar on a dark chip
brand.name_text: 'Yara' (Poppins) + 'AXLE' (JetBrains Mono, tracking 0.16em, orange #FB9800); page H1 repeats 'Yara AXLE' with a 36px BrandMark; page title metadata 'Yara AXLE'
brand.eyebrow: 'platform control' (mono, uppercase, 50% white) under the wordmark
brand.credit_line: none in the shell; AXLE sign-in reads 'platform control · AntaraX Ripple'
brand.other: Sidebar footer above the profile: pulsing green dot + 'authorized staff · audit-logged' (mono 10px uppercase). Build sha shown on the overview Data health card ('build local' or the Vercel commit).

items.label: Billing
items.gating: in-product payments are off; packages and invoices

items.label: AXLE admins
items.gating: lists reka_admin only; no create button

items.label: Help pages
items.gating: leaves the AXLE shell (public help pages)

global_controls.search: none (Topbar canSearch is false for reka_admin)
global_controls.notifications: Bell in the dark top bar linking to /notifications, with unread badge
global_controls.help: 'Help content' (AXLE editor) and 'Help pages' (/help) in the Platform group; 'FAQ & Support' in the user menu
global_controls.guide: 'AXLE guide' (/axle/guide) in the Platform group and in the user menu
global_controls.org_switcher: none; tenants are reached through Organizations and the overview table
global_controls.create_button: 'Invite someone' primary (teal) button on the overview header, links to /axle/invitations
global_controls.sign_out: Log out in the sidebar-footer user menu; note it redirects to /login (loginPath is hard-coded '/login' in Sidebar.tsx:260), which the AXLE host rewrites to /axle/login
global_controls.env_badge: none in the nav (build sha only on the overview Data health card)
global_controls.impersonation: none; tenant data is viewed through the /axle/companies/[id] drill-down, not by acting as a tenant
other: 'authorized staff · audit-logged' footer with pulsing green dot
Per-page guide + 3-step guided tour on the overview

surfaces.responsive: Identical to the customer shell: sidebar from lg (1024px), dark drawer with hamburger below lg. Overview stat grid 2 columns on phone, 4 from lg; the tenants table scrolls sideways on phones.
surfaces.active_state: 2px left border in AXLE orange #FB9800, background white at 6%, white text, orange icon; inactive text 60% white, icons 40% white, hover background white 4%
surfaces.fonts: Poppins for labels and body; JetBrains Mono for the AXLE wordmark, group labels, eyebrows, stat values (tabular-nums), table numbers and slugs
surfaces.a11y: As the customer shell. Top-bar focus ring uses teal offset on the dark surface. The pulsing authorized dot animates forever with no reduced-motion guard.
surfaces.role_variants: reka_admin only. Any other role requesting /axle is redirected to /dashboard without a hint that it exists (requireRekaAdmin).

widgets.title: Yara AXLE
widgets.detail: BrandMark + H1 'Yara AXLE' + 'Every tenant on the platform, and whether each is ready to run.'; 'Invite someone' button right

widgets.title: Every tenant, and whether it is ready (page guide)
widgets.detail: Dismissable guide card with 3 tips and a 3-step tour

widgets.title: Platform counts
widgets.detail: 4 axle StatCards: Organizations (hint 'N active · N inactive'), Users, Work Orders, Job Cards; mono eyebrow + mono value

widgets.title: Tenants

widgets.title: Recent audit log
widgets.detail: Last 15 audit_logs rows: action · entity type · actor, timestamp right

surfaces.name: Worker PWA (My Jobs)
surfaces.layout: Single column, max-w-lg (512px) centred, min-h-screen. Sticky white header bar (px-4 py-3, bottom border) with brand on the left and bell + avatar menu on the right. No sidebar, no bottom tabs; other screens (history, settings, notifications) are reached from the header menu and the bell.

brand.logo: Tenant company logo (28px) when set, otherwise BrandMark (antarax-ax-ripple-centered.svg, 28px)
brand.name_text: 'My Jobs' / 'Kerja Saya' (shell.title, translated), with the tenant company name beneath (10px muted)
brand.credit_line: none in the shell; worker sign-in shows 'Yara' + 'powered by AntaraX Ripple'
brand.other: The product name 'Yara' does not appear in the signed-in worker shell

items.label: My Jobs (brand link)
items.icon: custom inline SVG NavIcon 'brand mark' (18px, stroke 1.7)

items.label: Notifications (bell)
items.badge: unread count, red, 9+ cap, polled every 60s

global_controls.notifications: Bell (36px rounded square) linking to /worker/notifications with unread badge; translated aria-label
global_controls.guide: 'User guide' in the avatar menu; floating '?' re-opens the page guide
global_controls.org_switcher: none (company name shown under the title)
global_controls.language: Language page (/worker/settings) from the avatar menu: English or Bahasa Malaysia
global_controls.sign_out: 'Log out' in the avatar menu with a translated confirm dialog, then /worker-login

brand_gaps: Credit line reads 'Powered by AntaraX Ripple' in the sidebar head, sign-in panels, worker sign-in, splash and AXLE sign-in; the kit wants 'Yara · by AntaraX' in chrome and 'Yara by AntaraX, from REKA.' on sign-in (src/lib/brand.ts:3, Sidebar.tsx:198, LoginCard.tsx:51 and :63, SplashScreen.tsx:11, BrandLockup.tsx:30, axle/login/page.tsx:47).
AXLE is named 'Yara AXLE' (wordmark, page H1, page title via brand.adminLayerName); kit 13 §6 wants 'AXLE · Yara'.
AXLE look uses ink #0B0E14 / #12151E; kit 13 §6 specifies the dark product ground #071233, raised #0C1B47. Orange #FB9800 accent matches. AXLE primary button 'Invite someone' is teal, not orange.
AXLE lives at axle.yara.antarax.ai; kit target is axle.antarax.ai (one console for every product).
US spelling 'Organization' in the nav (Sidebar.tsx:73 and AXLE 'Organizations'), sign-in copy 'Every organization runs its own process' and worker sign-in 'Organization code'; kit wants organisation.
Role labels 'Owner / CEO / MD', 'Operation Manager', 'REKA staff' (constants.ts:11-17); kit wants Owner, Admin, REKA support (Supervisor and Worker stay).
'Log out' / 'Log in' everywhere; kit 13 §1 wants Sign in / Sign out.
'Users', 'Tenant users', 'Invite people' on screen; kit prefers member(s) and Invite.

Primary action colour is Ripple teal #08B0B3 (btn-primary); the Yara sheet sets primary action teal #098284 hover #05686A and accent dark #0B6E72 (app uses #078F92) and tint #D9F3F2 (app uses #E1F6F6).
Money shows 'RM 550,634.00' with a space; kit 13 §3 wants 'RM550,634.00', in JetBrains Mono tabular figures. Customer KPI values are Poppins, not mono.

Focus ring: AntaraX blue ring only on top-bar controls; sidebar links, filter chips and range buttons have no visible focus style. Reduced motion is honoured only in the guided tour; the authorized-staff pulse, worker running dot (animate-pulse) and page-guide animations ignore it.

No AI sparkle and no AntaraX app tile/product switcher (the A in the brand pill links to antarax.ai, which partly serves as the family touchpoint). Sign-in lacks the 'from REKA' trust line and the Ripple Rings composition; empty states do not use the awan larat motif.

Help: kit wants one Help item in every menu; the customer nav has both 'Help' and 'User guide', the user menu repeats them as 'FAQ & Support' and 'User guide', and the AXLE menu has 'Help content', 'Help pages' and 'AXLE guide'.
The worker shell never shows the product name or any AntaraX credit once signed in (only the tenant name and 'My Jobs').
Worker sign-in placeholder 'e.g. bric' names the first client's org code (src/components/auth/OrgCodeForm.tsx); the kit says not to name the customer without permission.
notes: Three shells share src/components/shared: the management AppShell (Sidebar + Topbar) serves both tenant roles and AXLE (dark when role is reka_admin), and a separate minimal WorkerShell serves the PWA. Nav is defined as two static arrays in Sidebar.tsx (CLIENT_SECTIONS filtered by role, AXLE_SECTIONS); no feature-flag or plan gating on nav items today. Screenshots were taken from a local dev server (port 3101) pointed at a throwaway mock Supabase on port 3201 that answered auth and PostgREST calls with fictional data (Demo Fabrication Sdn Bhd); no real backend was contacted. The live sign-in page could not be fetched (egress proxy refused yara.antarax.ai). Crawler screenshots in docs/screenshots/<role>/ are gitignored and absent from the clone; only docs/screenshots/tours/ is committed and it predates the current top bar. public/guide/*.jpg was retaken on 15 Oct 2026 and matches the current nav; public/guide/axl-overview.jpg also matches but shows the first client's name and live counts, so it was not copied.
